connections.description: A list of connections for the account.

dataSource.description: The data source type (for example, ExcelOnline, MailChimp).

lastModified.description: The date and time the connection was last modified.

externalId.description: Optional externalId set when the connection was created via redirect. Your identifier for this connection in your own system. Unique within a sub-account (null values are excluded from the uniqueness constraint). Use this field to correlate Connect AI connections with records in your own database. Distinct from the `external_identity` JWT claim, which is a per-request user-level audit identifier.

mcpUrl.description: The per-connection MCP endpoint URL, for example, /mcp/connections/{id}.

status.description: Connection status. Possible values include Authenticated, NotAuthenticated, and Conditional.
